limitations: Priced count includes distinct comparison-site banners and telehealth programs, not only independent dispensing pharmacies. Target (CVS), Duane Reade and Walgreens Specialty Pharmacy are grouped with their named operators for the stricter count. Telehealth can use shared dispensing channels.
Comparison sites not exhaustively verified for every dose. SingleCare Wegovy showed tablet pricing, excluded. GoodRx Mounjaro did not show local named quotes. No historical prices carried forward.
